newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Manila's PHIBOR rise as banks remain wary.
newsitem.headline: Manila's PHIBOR rise as banks remain wary.

text.p: The Philippine interbank offered rates (PHIBOR) rose in all maturities as banks remained wary over the direction of interest rates, traders said.
"Banks are still cautious about their lending rates. Very few banks were quoting in the swap market," one trader from a big local bank said.
Bankers were anticipating spot rates to go higher after the Central Bank raised its one-month reverse repo rate and Treasury bill rates rose sharply in the auction on Monday.
"We don't know how high the rates will go," another trader said. PHIBOR are the average swap quotes of 20 banks in the country.
